item.title: Singapore's birthrate crisis offers policy lessons for the U.S.
item.description: Singapore launched a national plan to address its low birthrate, and demographers suggest some policies could inform U.S. approaches.

item.title: Russian drone attacks empty Kyiv shelves and unsettle residents
item.description: For a fifth day, Russian forces struck Kyiv and its surroundings, causing some supermarket shortages and heightened anxiety among Ukrainians.

item.title: Many women receive antibiotics for UTIs they do not actually have
item.description: A study shows that many women treated for recurring UTIs were misdiagnosed, with symptoms stemming from hormonal factors instead.
